description: This collection maps industrial heat-source objects operating in India during 2012–2021. The Aerospace Information Research Institute and Beijing Forestry University researchers publish identifiers, bounding coordinates, active-fire counts, administrative locations and inferred operating start and end times. ScienceDB hosts the dataset for spatial analysis of industrial activity. Its repository licence is CC BY-NC-ND 4.0, providing free access with restrictions on commercial reuse and distributing modified material. The inspected metadata does not specify the output format. Thermal detections provide an activity proxy, not audited factory openings, electricity demand or process capacity. The objects can help allocate industrial demand and exposure in regional infrastructure simulations if those limitations are retained. No directly related catalogue record was identified for this India-specific inventory.
name: A dataset of industrial heat sources in operation in India from 2012 to 2021
